name: Adani Enterprises
about: Adani Enterprises Limited (AEL), part of the Adani Group, specializes in incubating and developing businesses across energy, transportation, consumer goods, and primary industries. AEL’s portfolio includes renewable energy, green hydrogen production, data centers, water management, airports, roads, mining services, and defense manufacturing. With a strategic focus on creating self-sustaining entities, AEL has successfully spun off six companies, including Adani Ports, Adani Power, and Adani Green Energy. Through its diversified ventures, AEL is committed to meeting India’s evolving needs and driving sustainable growth, making it a pivotal player in the country's infrastructure and energy sectors.
